This '''palace''' on [[Revkinn V]] was the headquarters of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Linrec]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. His underling, [[Imperial Prefect|Prefect]] [[Dengless Rinn]] of [[Kallistas]], planned to take over the palace.
